meta.name: Assistant
meta.description: An AI agent that customises the platform with change sets people review, apply and roll back

assistant-user.name: Assistant user
assistant-user.description: Use the assistant and prepare change sets for the surfaces you can see

assistant-admin.name: Assistant administrator
assistant-admin.description: See every change set, and edit, discard or withdraw anyone’s

permissions.use: Use the assistant and prepare change sets for the configuration you can see
permissions.changeSetsManage: Edit, discard or withdraw anyone’s change sets

settings.maxToolRoundsHelp: How many rounds of tool calls the assistant may make before it must answer (1–30).

changeSet.name: Change set review
changeSet.description: Runs when someone requests a review of a change set. When it is approved, the change set is applied with the approver’s permissions.

change_set_returned.label: My change sets come back to me
change_set_returned.title: {reference} is back in draft

change_set_rolled_back.label: My change sets are rolled back
change_set_rolled_back.title: {reference} was rolled back

audit.change-set_submitted: Requested a review of a change set
audit.change-set_withdrawn: Withdrew a change set from review
audit.change-set_returned: A change set went back to draft

server.builtin: No AI chat model is configured, so I can’t take free-text requests yet. Use one of the guided templates below to prepare a change, or ask an administrator to set up a model in Administration → AI.
server.empty: I couldn’t finish that. Try rephrasing the request, or open the change set to see where it stands.

mode.builtinHint: No AI chat model is configured, so the assistant offers guided templates instead of free text.
mode.llmHint: Answers come from the AI model your administrator configured. The assistant works as you, with your permissions; it asks you to confirm before it applies or rolls back anything.

panel.title: Assistant
panel.description: Describe what you want or pick a template. The assistant works as you, with your permissions, and asks before it applies anything.
panel.loadError: The assistant couldn’t be loaded. Try again in a moment.
panel.noKinds: There is nothing you can customise yet
panel.noKindsHint: Without an AI model, the assistant offers guided templates for configuration you can see, such as approval workflows or request forms. Ask an administrator for access to what you need, or to set up a model so you can also ask for everyday work.
panel.noTools: There is nothing the assistant can do for you yet
panel.noToolsHint: The assistant works through the platform’s tools and configuration with your permissions, and your roles don’t include any of them yet. Ask an administrator for the access you need.

chat.hint: Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line. The assistant sees the page you are on.
chat.welcomeTitle: What would you like to change?
chat.welcomeBody: Describe it in your own words. I work with the platform’s real configuration as you, and I ask before I apply anything.
chat.workBody: Ask for everyday work in your own words, such as finding a ticket or adding a note to it. I work as you, with your permissions, and I ask before anything that needs your confirmation.

starter.approval: Laptop requests over 60,000 TWD also need approval from IT asset management
starter.field: Add a cost centre field to people
starter.form: Create a request form for a second monitor

chat.networkError: The connection dropped. Check your network and try again.

names.assistant_list_kinds: Looking at what can be customised

card.title: Change set {reference}
card.items: {count, plural, =0 {No changes yet} one {# change} other {# changes}}
card.needsApprover: {count, plural, one {# needs a reviewer} other {# need a reviewer}}

templates.title: Guided templates
templates.intro: Pick what you want to change and answer a few questions. I prepare a change set for you to review.
templates.nothingLive: Nothing changes yet: the change goes into a change set that you review and apply.
templates.needsReviewer: You can prepare this change; applying it needs someone with the permission, so request a review.
templates.addingTo: New changes are added to this change set.
templates.noTemplates: No guided templates for what you can change
templates.noTemplatesHint: An administrator can configure an AI chat model in Administration → AI so you can describe other changes in your own words.
templates.withoutTemplates: Without an AI chat model, these have no guided template: {kinds}.

list.title: Change sets
list.description: Configuration changes prepared with the assistant. Nothing is live until someone applies it, and an applied change set can be rolled back.
list.emptyHint: Open the assistant with the sparkles button in the header to prepare one.
list.liveCount: {count, plural, one {# change set} other {# change sets}}

detail.notFound: This change set doesn’t exist, or you can’t see it.
detail.editDescription: The title and summary of {reference}, as reviewers see them.
detail.summaryHint: What the change set does and why. Reviewers read it in their approval.
detail.refreshed: The change set now uses the current versions

missing.title: You can’t apply this change set yourself
missing.body: Applying it needs {permissions}. Request a review: an approver who holds them applies it.
missing.bodyInReview: Applying it needs {permissions}. An approver who holds them applies it when they approve the review.

rollbackBlocked.notReversible: Some changes can’t be undone automatically (a delete), so this change set can’t be rolled back here.
rollbackBlocked.other: This change set can’t be rolled back automatically.

detail.itemsTitle: Changes, in the order they apply
detail.itemsEmptyHint: Add changes from the assistant panel.
detail.destructiveNote: This change set archives or deletes something: applying it needs an explicit confirmation.

lastError.title: The last attempt didn’t go through
lastError.noApprover: The review was approved without a person who could apply it. Apply it yourself, or request a review again.
lastError.stale: Someone changed {items} after this change set was prepared. Refresh it, review the differences, then try again.
lastError.staleGeneric: Someone changed the configuration after this change set was prepared. Refresh it, review the differences, then try again.
lastError.forbidden: Applying it needed permissions the person applying doesn’t hold: {permissions}.
lastError.privilege: Applying it would grant permissions the person applying doesn’t hold.
lastError.notReversible: Some changes can’t be undone automatically.

actionErrors.validation: Some changes fail their dry run. Fix or remove them first.
actionErrors.forbidden: This needs permissions you don’t hold: {permissions}.
actionErrors.stale: Someone changed {items} after this change set was prepared. Refresh it and review the differences first.
actionErrors.notReversible: Some changes can’t be undone automatically.

review.title: In review
review.approveApplies: Approving the review applies the change set with the approver’s permissions.

item.refTarget: The object created by “{ref}” in this change set
item.removeBody: “{label}” is removed from {reference}. Later changes that refer to it fail their dry run until they are fixed.
item.stale: This object changed after the change was proposed. Review the differences below, then refresh the change set to accept the current version as the base.
item.currentUnavailable: The current object can’t be read, so the whole proposed value is shown.
item.archiveNote: Applying archives this object. Rolling back restores it.
item.deleteNote: Applying deletes this object. A delete can’t be rolled back.

check.needsApprover: Needs someone with more permissions to apply it
check.needsPermission: Needs someone with {permission} to apply it

diff.label: Differences from {before} to {after}
diff.none: No differences: the proposed value is the same as the current one.
diff.more: {count, plural, one {# more difference isn’t shown} other {# more differences aren’t shown}}

apply.title: Apply {reference}?
apply.body: Every change is applied in one transaction with your permissions: if one fails, nothing is applied. You can roll it back afterwards.
apply.inReview: This change set is in review. Applying it now cancels the review.
apply.notReady: Some changes didn’t pass their dry run, so applying will probably fail.
apply.destructiveConfirm: {count, plural, one {I understand that # object will be archived or deleted} other {I understand that # objects will be archived or deleted}}

submit.title: Request a review of {reference}
submit.body: An approver reviews the changes and their dry run. Approving applies the change set with the approver’s permissions.

withdraw.title: Withdraw the review of {reference}?
withdraw.body: The review is cancelled and the change set goes back to draft, so you can change it again.

rollback.title: Roll back {reference}?
rollback.body: Every change is undone in one transaction, in reverse order: updates go back to their earlier values, archived objects are restored and created ones are removed. Objects someone changed since can’t be rolled back.
rollback.reason: Reason (optional, kept in the audit log)

discard.title: Discard {reference}?
discard.body: The draft is closed and can’t be applied any more. Nothing in the configuration changes.

confirm.title: Confirm before it runs
confirm.hint: The assistant asked to do this. Nothing happens unless you confirm, and it runs with your permissions.
confirm.reviewFirst: Review the changes before you confirm
confirm.alreadyDecided: This was already decided. The conversation shows what happened.
confirm.alreadyExpired: This expired when the conversation moved on. Ask the assistant again if you still want it.
